prompt:
Research the fee OpenRouter charges when buying credits (card and crypto), and any fee on bring-your-own-key usage. Cite OpenRouter's own documentation or FAQ and quote it.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on OpenRouter's official documentation, FAQ, and pricing pages, here are the fees associated with purchasing credits and using Bring Your Own Keys (BYOK).

When purchasing credits with a card (non-crypto), OpenRouter charges a 5.5% fee with a minimum of $0.80. For cryptocurrency payments, the fee is 5.0%. There is no markup on the actual inference pricing from the underlying model providers. For users who bring their own provider keys (BYOK), there is a $25,000 monthly free allowance (measured by list-price inference cost), after which a 5% fee is applied based on what the equivalent usage would normally cost on OpenRouter. This BYOK fee is deducted from your OpenRouter credits.

SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/docs/faq | QUOTE: "OpenRouter charges a 5.5% ($0.80 minimum) fee when you purchase credits." | CLAIM: The fee percentage and minimum amount for purchasing credits using non-crypto payment methods.
SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/docs/faq | QUOTE: "Crypto payments are charged a fee of 5%." | CLAIM: The fee percentage for purchasing credits using cryptocurrency.
SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/docs/faq | QUOTE: "Usage above the allowance has a fee of 5% of what the same model and provider would normally cost on OpenRouter." | CLAIM: The usage-based fee applied to BYOK usage that exceeds the free allowance.
SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/pricing | QUOTE: "BYOK Limits Learn more → | Free No | Standard $25,000 of list price inference / month with no fees, 5% fee after" | CLAIM: The $25,000 monthly free allowance for standard BYOK usage before the 5% fee applies.
SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/auth/byok | QUOTE: "The cost of using custom provider keys on OpenRouter is 5% of what the same model/provider would cost normally on OpenRouter and will be deducted from your OpenRouter credits." | CLAIM: How the BYOK fee is calculated and the mechanism by which it is billed.
SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/blog/announcements/simplifying-our-platform-fee/ | QUOTE: "Non-crypto payments: 5.5% of the order amount, with a minimum fee of $0.80" | CLAIM: Confirmation of the updated non-crypto credit purchase fee structure.
SOURCE: https://openrouter.ai/blog/announcements/simplifying-our-platform-fee/ | QUOTE: "Crypto payments: 5.0% flat, no minimum fee" | CLAIM: Confirmation of the updated crypto credit purchase fee structure.
